$comment: The machine-readable command manifest of ks. One row per verb the binary dispatches; manifest_test.go fails the build if this file and the source disagree in either direction. Downstream (keepstate.ai/docs/cli and its verb-count lint) renders FROM this file and must never hand-type a verb. Rows may carry `safety` (a refusal the product makes on the customer's behalf, which the docs page renders as the safety property it is) and `budgetDefaults` (the per-tier session token budget). Both are DESCRIPTIONS OF MEASURED OR SOURCED BEHAVIOUR, and manifest_test.go fails if a row states one without saying where the number came from. A two-word verb (`cruise init`) is a subcommand: the first word is the case arm in main.go, the second the case arm in cruise.go's runCruise; both directions are checked. Rows may carry `flags`, one entry per flag with its one-line meaning.

budgetDefaults.freeProvenance: measured 2026-09-09 on the released client against a disposable free-tier account (DEC-01 command gate)
budgetDefaults.paidProvenance: stated by the control plane, ctl/broker.go, and the ratified price book v1.2. NOT measured: no paid account was exercised.

commands.safety: Refuses a session that has no saved checkpoint, because killing it would destroy unsaved work, and names both ways out: `ks checkpoint <id> --stop` saves and stops it, `ks kill <id> --force` destroys it anyway.
commands.safetyMeasured: 2026-09-09, DEC-01 command gate, released client against a disposable account. The guard is enforced by the daemon, not the client, so it holds for every caller including the console.

commands.summary: run one command in the session
interactive terminal into a running session (tmux)
commands.note: relays the guest tmux over a control-plane upgrade tunnel; live resize is a v1 limitation

commands.summary: branch a checkpoint into diverging children
commands.note: paid plans only; each child is another running session

commands.usage: ks cruise init [--goal TEXT] [--tests CMD] [--paths GLOB...] [--ladder family:model,...] [--spend USD]
commands.summary: draft the acceptance manifest from the repository into .keepstate/cruise.json

flags.summary: the goal the agent is given; without it, the draft's previous goal, else "make the check pass: CMD"
the command that decides done, when init should not detect it (pytest, npm test, go test)
the paths an attempt may change; default every tracked file except the tests and .keepstate
the rungs in order; default the model table's default ladder
the spend ceiling in dollars; default 2

commands.note: makes no request and never calls a model; a repository with no check is refused with exit 2 and nothing written

commands.summary: lock the draft: its digest and the time into .keepstate/cruise.lock
commands.note: makes no request; refused when the workspace changed since init

commands.summary: upload the workspace and the locked manifest; start the job
commands.safety: Refuses, before any request: a draft without a lock (run `ks cruise approve`), a workspace over 50 MiB (.git and .keepstate excluded), a test file changed since approve (the tests_digest differs), a draft changed since approve, and a workspace changed since approve.
commands.safetyMeasured: 2026-09-16, cruise_test.go (TestCruiseRunRefusals) against a recording control plane: each refusal exits non-zero with zero requests.

commands.summary: the job (or the newest): state, rung, each attempt, save points, spend, verdict, artifact
the event stream, one event per line: seq, ts, type, detail
resume a job from review, on the same or a wider ladder

flags.summary: the rungs to continue on, in order
where to write it; default JOB.tar.gz

commands.safety: Verifies the download's sha256 against the job's artifact_sha before the named file exists; a mismatch is refused and nothing is written.
commands.safetyMeasured: 2026-09-16, cruise_test.go (TestCruiseArtifactVerifiesBeforeWriting) against a control plane serving a tampered artifact.

commands.summary: the model table the control plane serves: families, rungs, default ladder
